discrepancy: The request uses the July 3 sheet (v2-0). v2-1 (July 24) is the latest named inputs, but Milo's July 30 message says the v2-1 mass may be 8 kg high because ballast was on the scale, with a re-weigh pending. No re-weigh has been posted. With the 96 to 40 percent budget of 2.912 kWh, 22 m/s is not feasible at either 318 kg (3.045 kWh) or 310 kg (3.022 kWh). The mass question does not change the feasibility answer for this request, but it does change the margin and the max speed, and it is unresolved.
why_it_matters: Either mass gives a shortfall of at least 0.11 kWh at 22 m/s. Which mass is right decides whether the max constant speed is 21.30 or 21.43 m/s. The reviewer cannot pick one; only a re-weigh can.

resolution: Milo posts the re-weigh result, or states that 318 kg stands. Until then neither mass is final and the run is blocked on that answer.
